The industry is expected to witness continued capacity additions of around 70-75 million MT over FY 2025-26, with a significant portion expected to come on stream during FY 2026.
Growth & demand: The housing segment, accounting for nearly 55% of domestic cement consumption, continues to be the largest demand driver, with steady growth expected from both rural housing and urban real estate projects.

The growing housing sector, which typically accounts for 55% to 60% of India's cement consumption, will also continue to remain a key demand driversupported by sustained demand from both rural housing and urban residential construction.

The cement industry may witness moderation in demand growth during FY 2025-26, driven by a slower pace of construction activity in certain regions, delays in infrastructure project execution, and cyclical softness in housing and real estate demand.
